name: Belize National Cybersecurity Strategy — Towards A Secure Cyberspace 2020–2023
owner: Public Utilities Commission of Belize / National Cybersecurity Task Force
description: Belize National Cybersecurity Strategy — Towards A Secure Cyberspace 2020–2023 (June 13, 2020). National cybersecurity strategy of Belize developed with support from the OAS/CICTE and Commonwealth Secretariat.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Public Utilities Commission of Belize / National Cybersecurity Task Force (puc.bz) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Public Utilities Commission of Belize / National Cybersecurity Task Force (puc.bz).

license.note: Official publication (puc.bz); Belize Copyright Act (Chapter 252, Part IX Government copyright); no general statutory public-domain exemption for ministerial or regulatory strategy reports without explicit open licensing.
